title: Remove desk vocabulary from procedures and procedure keys (S)
description:
'Desk' is retired vocabulary: Ryan said on 2026-10-21 to use 'section', and attribution is just 'AI'. It survives about 103 times across procedures/ and the procedure registry, including the CLI key edition-plan.rotating-desk and rotating_section_selector's header ('rotating desk selector').

Fix:
- Rename to section wording, for example edition-plan.rotating-section.
- Keep the old CLI key as a deprecated alias for one release.
- Remove 'desk' from prompts, so AI output never echoes it.

Acceptance:
- A grep test: no 'desk' anywhere in procedures/ or the registry, apart from the alias line.
- The old key still works and prints a deprecation note.
